faqSub: Essential details on purchasing, delivery, and payment terms
faq1Q: Do the products have quality certificates?
faq1A: Yes, all pipes, industrial valves and electrical supplies come with factory datasheets and certified GOST/ISO documentation.
faq2Q: How is delivery arranged to regions?
faq2A: Deliveries across Tashkent and all Uzbekistan regions are dispatched on the same day via trusted logistics carriers.
faq3A: Payments are accepted via bank transfer with VAT for corporate clients, as well as cash or card for retail clients.
faq4Q: Are there wholesale volume discounts for major construction projects?
faq4A: Yes, special wholesale contract pricing and phased supply terms are provided for large contractors and developers according to project bill of quantities.
